answer: Because the timing is logged against the quill challenge, the mesa audit can replay the crystal history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 93 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1794 identities would post 3427 proofs and burn roughly 56 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
